  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones Chapter of the Ones

Puṇṇātherīgāthā Puṇṇā Verses of the Elder Puṇṇā

“Puṇṇe pūrassu dhammehi, Puṇṇā, be filled with good qualities, “Puṇṇā, grow full of good qualities, Cando pannaraseriva; like the moon on the fifteenth day. like the moon on the fifteenth day. Paripuṇṇāya paññāya, When your wisdom is full, Full of wisdom, Tamokhandhaṁ padālayā”ti. shatter the mass of darkness. destroy this mass of darkness.”

Itthaṁ sudaṁ puṇṇā therī gāthaṁ abhāsitthāti. That is how this verse was recited by the senior nun Puṇṇā. Thus Puṇṇā the Elder spoke this verse.
